holderQuote: Ksmvr flew upwards, Forceshield raised. He slashed with his dagger and shortsword as the swarm turned on him. He landed on a moth, crushing its back, leapt again. He landed and ran left, dodging the moths swarming around him.
effectQuote: “Jumping. I am a target! [Focus of Ire]! Attack me, you snacks!”
